text:
erica: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8419 — prefill: limit concurrent prefill tasks on tiny-batch path. TL;DR: should reduce overall prefill pressure but microbench showed a p95 bump for 4k-longseq/tiny-batch. need quick eyes before merge.

sam: ping @raj @julia — who can do perf + alloc checks? we need a 2nd approval for merge window.

raj: I can take perf. can you paste bench artifact / raw numbers?

erica: artifact: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/8419/prefill-smoke-6223
quick numbers: baseline (main) 4k-longseq tiny-batch p95 = 128ms, PR8419 p95 = 182ms (+42%). throughput about the same, mem +120MB peak. attached flamegraph and logs in artifact.

julia: wow that's a visible tail hit. can you share the exact bench command + runtime config used?

erica: sure — bench command + config I used:
```
./bench --model=redwood/4k-longseq --seq=4096 --batch=minibatch --tiny-batches=4 --iters=200
runtime.config:
  prefill_concurrency: 2  # PR changed from 8 -> 2
  microbatch_size: 16
```

sam: that drop in prefill_concurrency could explain more blocking on some shards. why does it affect p95 and not median?

raj: likely head-of-line for a subset of requests — fewer concurrent prefill workers increases probability a request waits for a worker and loses tail. KV prefill starvation pattern.

erica: pushed update `pr8419.1` that sets default prefill_concurrency=4 and adds per-model override. updated PR description and pushed new bench artifacts.

ci-bot: Canary perf run uploaded: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/8419/canary-6224 — canary passed unit tests; perf shows p95 still slightly up on 4k-longseq: p95=140ms.

julia: can you run a targeted microbench with `--prefill-concurrency=4` and attach logs?

erica: ran it, results: p95=140ms (baseline 128ms => +9%). memory delta minimal. sample log lines showing contention:
"[2026-03-10T04:12:33Z] prefill: waited 13ms for token fetch lock (shard=7)"

sam: ok so 4 is a reasonable compromise for now — reduces the large regression but still not perfect. long-term we should make prefill adaptive to inflight batches or add a fast-path for tiny-batch.

raj: agreed. for this PR I propose: land with prefill_concurrency=4, add a rollout guard (canary only) and a follow-up perf ticket to implement adaptive prefill. also add dashboard alert for p95 > 20% increase.

erica: done — updated PR with rollout guard + created ticket #1123 for adaptive prefill + monitoring. I added a note "do not promote to prod until #1123 triaged".

julia: LGTM from perf side if we land prefill=4 and add the monitoring + rollback plan.

sam: approving now. :+1: merging to canary at 04:20 UTC. I'll post canary metrics in #eng-runtime after deploy.

erica: thanks everyone. merging now. please don't promote to prod until we verify canary and #1123 is in triage.

ops-bot: Deploy started: deploy/6223456789 -> canary (region=us-west), ETA ~3m.

erica: noted — will monitor. will follow up with a short write-up in the PR with the bench diffs and next steps.

sam: thanks — leave a perf dashboard watch and tag me if tail stays >15% for >30m.

erica: will do. :thumbsup:
